page.overview:
Who is Jimmy Fallon?

James Thomas "Jimmy" Fallon (born September 19, 1974) is an American comedian, television host, actor, musician, writer, and producer. He is known for his work in television as a cast member on and as the host of late-night talk show .

Jimmy Fallon appeared in a Gyrosphere instruction video, where he said the glass is able to stop a 50 caliber bullet and can protect the guests from the venomous spit of a Dilophosaurus, with him acting as if he passed out from the venom. Zach Mitchell and Gray Mitchell, who were watching the instruction video sighed, implying they didn’t find the skit funny. In the end of the video the a device on the table begins to explode, causing Fallon to cover his head and scream frantically.
